verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents locations and zones for managing readers across sites, on a page variant scoped to the API (dashboard-or-api=api). It also documents registering readers to a location by serial number without physical access, and offers an MCP server through which agents can call the Stripe API. However, no evidence explicitly shows a create-location endpoint or API-based reader registration, and reader management is described as a Dashboard feature. missing for 10: explicit API documentation for creating locations, explicit API endpoint for registering readers to a location, an end-to-end agent provisioning example, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: You can streamline the management of multiple readers across different physical sites by using locations and zones.
You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it
You must register your reader to a location to accept payments.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
